reviews.reviewerContext: /root/reach_render_review — independent separate read-only reviewer; fresh rendered documentation-baseline verification before source identity comparison
reviews.acceptanceScope: Fresh anonymous desktop/mobile D0 software/browser packet for 4642246fdb13d2ff7da3ba16718bd2e5602b65c6, reconciled from the preserved accepted b078 review with an unchanged product digest. No unresolved blocker within the contract. Historical D1 remains bound to 632e1895a6fcd8ba4c82f1752f6b671131598a33; physical D4 and owner acceptance are not claimed.

composition.observation: Fresh welcome uses a larger registered camera column beside guidance, and calibration gives the target plane priority. Phone acquisition sits above the plane. Cream serif headings, brass outlines and sea-green panels form the same instrument within the shared shell. The Devices doorway is usable at entry and in recovery but its flush-left placement and one clipped phone-return sample remain minor polish.

hierarchy.observation: Prepare, Calibrate, Check and Explore remain distinct. Fresh demo tracking separates hand detection, framing and recognized point. FIT_READY says Independent check required and Not measured, whereas results say Independent check passed. Detected-ineligible preserves detection while asking for framing; training is not presented as validated action eligibility.

typography.observation: Fresh 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 phone screenshots retain readable cream serif task headings and plain instructions. Eyebrows label stages without being the sole readiness cue. Phone result labels and explanatory units wrap within panels; ordinary controls remain legible. Video scaling is proportional and does not itself establish physical-device readability.

spacing.observation: Fresh phone absolute NORMAL and REDUCED videos at 16s show target 6, 5 of 9 saved and 87% collection together. At 24s the independent target, compact progress and Pause check/Cancel check coexist, with 67% NORMAL and 73% REDUCED. Desktop guidance remains beside the plane. The working target is not separated from hold feedback by a screen.

controls.observation: Enable live camera and Explore guided demo are explicit choices. Relative is recommended and absolute experimental. Fresh pause offers Resume calibration; independent absolute/relative validation says Pause check and Cancel check. Retry, practice, recalibration and conventional Device connections actions remain visible. Guided demo controls disclose simulation and no physical-accuracy proof.

contrast.observation: Cream instructions, brass actions/outlines and mint progress remain distinguishable on dark panels. Text accompanies modes and readiness; the provisional amber pointer is explained. Fresh recorded keyboard interaction shows strong focus outlines around target and action controls. Automated no-serious-violation observations are supporting evidence, not every visual or assistive-technology combination.

consistency.observation: The fresh shared header/account access and brass/cream/sea-green treatment agree with the accepted Homeport references inspected in the initial review. Camera, target, guidance and results retain their treatment across modes. Relative results correctly use cursor error. The Devices doorway remains less integrated than the padded instrument and connection card.

states.observation: The fresh packet contains all fifteen states across both device and motion modes. I visually checked all fifteen distinct desktop NORMAL states and key phone stages. Pause/resume, required independent check, passed results, practice, active-hand choice, framing-ineligible detection, relative setup/check/results and unavailable-camera recovery remain distinct. No additional calibration-eligibility confusion appeared.

responsive.observation: Fresh desktop preparation/calibration use the intended two-column hierarchy. At 390x844 the phone prioritizes compact acquisition and the target, then wrapped actions. NORMAL/REDUCED video samples keep target/progress/check controls together. Expanded full-page stills alter sticky-shell positions; ordinary viewport samples do not obstruct the working target. The normal phone return doorway is clipped in one retained viewport position, recorded as minor polish.

keyboard.observation: All twelve fresh trace action streams contain Tab/Enter and role-targeted keyboard activations for entry, disclosed demo, setup, target acquisition, independent checking, practice and return; absolute includes pause/resume and condition changes. Radio/condition arrow keys are present. Absolute streams have 27 key activations, relative 16 and recovery 4. These do not prove a complete linear Tab traversal or every diagnostic/screen-reader control.

focus.observation: Fresh stills show gold focus outlines on welcome heading, target plane and Resume calibration. Viewport samples show focused acquisition buttons and radio/menu use reaches intended outcomes through trace activations. The shared shell stays above the working target in ordinary samples. One normal phone returned doorway sits under the header; this is recorded separately, without claiming a complete focus-order audit.

feedback.observation: Fresh acquisition combines hold wording, progress, saved count and target rings. Phone absolute 16s shows 87%, check 24s 67% NORMAL/73% REDUCED; phone relative NORMAL check 16s shows 73%. Named readiness feedback is 831.3–867.6ms against 5000ms. A secondary desktop Target saved sentence can remain while the next hold collects; primary target/progress stay clear, so this is nonblocking wording polish.

motion.observation: All twelve fresh recordings were sampled, covering both NORMAL and REDUCED acquisition, checking and recovery on desktop and phone. No persistent obstruction or frozen working stage appeared. Entry includes a sampled crossfade, and motion preferences are recorded in metadata/traces. Sampling does not prove continuous smoothness or physical motion feel. D1 timing remains historical at 632e1895 and is not a new run.

continuity.observation: Fresh desktop 0.5s entry shows Devices and 1s Reach camera-off welcome; phone 0.5s samples the transition and 1s shows welcome. Absolute and camera-recovery recordings return to the connection card/shared shell. All twelve records preserve the same home-origin fingerprint before, at outcomes and after return. One phone doorway viewport is clipped, while other returns show it; this does not undo the conventional return outcome. Historical D1 cleanup remains source632e1895.

complexity.observation: The fresh primary flow asks for one task at a time: choose camera/demo, choose mode, acquire, independently check, practice or retry. Diagnostics/privacy stay collapsed. Demo controls are separately disclosed. Phone progress repeats some guidance but stays beside the task. The interface does not require implementation knowledge; lingering secondary target-saved wording is polish rather than a new decision burden.

role-outcomes.observation: The anonymous Creator/Player enters through Devices without pairing or an automatic camera grant, chooses an explicit demo, sees distinct hand/readiness stages, selects absolute or relative setup, acquires targets, independently checks five new targets, practices safely and returns. Absolute is experimental/session-local; relative says cursor control and cursor error; demo results disclaim webcam accuracy. This accepts the bounded software/browser objective, not D4 or owner approval.

fallbacks.observation: Fresh unavailable-camera states explain The camera could not start and offer Retry live camera plus Explore guided demo. All four recovery videos show a labeled no-camera demo at 4s and return by their inspected tail samples. Pause/resume and framing guidance support intermediate recovery without equating detection with eligibility. The permission-denied viewport is historical 632e1895 evidence; actual webcam grant is not established.

findings.observation: Initial phone screenshots put acquisition/progress about a screen away from the illuminated target, preventing convenient monitoring of a hold.
findings.resolution: Resolved in fresh current viewports: compact progress sits immediately above the plane. Phone absolute 16s has target 6, 5 of 9 saved and 87% collection together in both motion modes. At 24s independent target/progress and Pause check/Cancel check coexist (67% NORMAL; 73% REDUCED). Relative phone NORMAL 16s shows 73% during an independent hold.

findings.observation: Initial held-out validation incorrectly named its pause/cancel actions calibration, weakening the separation between fit and independent check.
findings.resolution: Resolved in fresh absolute and relative check renders: Pause check and Cancel check are explicit, the plane says Independent check, and its amber provisional fit is not changed by these targets. FIT_READY requests five new targets rather than claiming training was validated.

findings.observation: Initial photographic tracking said the camera was connected/ready while simultaneously requesting camera permission.
findings.resolution: Historical D1 repair retained with source boundary: the 632e1895 registered photographic tracking viewport says Camera connected, Your hand is ready and Camera ready without contradictory permission copy. Fresh D0 tracking agrees on disclosed demo/no camera. After fresh rendered inspection, read-only comparisons found no changes in the bounded Reach/projection paths from 632e1895 to 4642246f, nor runtime/public/test/script/contract paths from accepted 8f163c32. This is not a fresh D1 run.

findings.observation: The initial packet omitted recordings and complete relative, entry/return, paused/fit-ready and motion evidence, so significant acceptance could not be inferred.
findings.resolution: Resolved: fresh packet includes 84 screenshots, twelve recordings and twelve traces, all fifteen states and the complete device/motion journey matrix. This unchanged-product documentation-baseline verification inspected 21 fresh screenshots and 35 frames across all twelve videos, plus all fresh trace action streams and journey metadata. The prior full accepted reviews remain intact. D4 and owner acceptance are unclaimed.

findings.observation: Initial expanded stills apparently placed shell/skip-link elements across the stage; without viewport records their product/capture cause was ambiguous.
findings.resolution: Resolved for the working stage: fresh ordinary viewport samples keep the shell above acquisition, target and check controls, including phone NORMAL/REDUCED 16s and 24s. Expanded full-page stills still shift sticky shell/skip-link positions; their expanded coordinates do not establish ordinary working-target obstruction. The separate returned doorway clipping is retained as minor polish, not hidden by this resolution.

findings.observation: Initial passed-results planes retained an obsolete instruction to hold at an illuminated acquisition target.
findings.resolution: Resolved in fresh absolute and relative passed results: Your setup stays local to this pointing area replaces the obsolete acquisition-target request under Independent check passed.

findings.observation: The Devices doorway remains a plain flush-left link outside the padded connection card. Desktop/reduced/fallback returns show it clearly; normal phone absolute tail frames at 38.6s and 39.2s show its text behind the sticky shell with only an underline visible, while the Devices card and shared navigation remain available. This small doorway placement/viewport continuity issue is nonblocking for the reviewed entry-to-return objective.
findings.recommendation: Integrate the existing doorway into the page's padded hierarchy below the sticky shell and ensure the returned viewport/focus reveals it. Keep its conventional accessible link. The observed task completes; the evidence does not establish the specific cause of the clipped tail sample.

findings.observation: A secondary desktop instruction says Target saved. Take a breath and move to the next one while the current absolute target 5 is collecting 67% at 16s, and relative target 2 is collecting 67% at 8s. The primary Hold here collecting percentage/ring and saved count are clear, so this is nonblocking feedback wording polish rather than a failed hold.
findings.recommendation: When the next hold begins, replace the previous target-saved secondary sentence with guidance matching the current acquisition state; retain the clear primary progress feedback.

renderedInspection.recordingMethod: Read-only fresh FFmpeg extraction inspected via view_image. Timestamps locate samples, not measured action latency. All twelve videos sampled; continuous playback is not claimed.

renderedInspection.supplementaryBoundary: Original photographic D1 screenshots/metrics and controlled development views remain source632e1895, were inspected in the prior accepted review and were not rerun for 4642246f. They are not fresh capture artifact IDs.

supportingMeasurements.captureFeedbackBoundary: Visible-control activation to changed rendered readiness or next-stage outcome; software UI feedback only, excluding camera exposure or inference accuracy
supportingMeasurements.traceInspection: All twelve current action streams inspected, including Tab/Enter, role-targeted keys and applicable arrows; entry/return targets and outcomes present. Complete linear Tab traversal is not established.

photographicD1.boundary: Software capture to canvas submission; excludes sensor exposure/display scanout

limitations: Fresh capture is D0; original D1 belongs to 632e1895. Neither proves real-person D4 webcam accuracy, physical ergonomics or owner acceptance.
Unchanged bounded source identity and product digest preserve historical D1 repair support, not a fresh D1 runtime/performance qualification for 4642246f.
Absolute empirical RGB pointing remains experimental/session-specific. Relative cursor control has a separate mapping, independent check and claim.

21 fresh screenshot artifacts and 35 sampled video frames were visually inspected. All 108 files were hash-verified; hashing is not visual inspection of every artifact/frame. Prior accepted fuller reviews remain preserved.

Expanded full-page stills change sticky positions; viewport samples govern working-target obstruction. The normal phone returned doorway clipping is explicitly retained as nonblocking polish; its exact product/capture cause is not established.
Fresh readiness timing and historical D1 capture/canvas timing use named software boundaries, excluding exposure/scanout. Samples do not prove continuous smoothness or sensor-to-photon feel.

Anonymous journeys and role-targeted keyboard activation do not qualify every authenticated role, complete linear Tab traversal, every assistive technology, physical touch device or unvisited diagnostic export/deletion control.
Pairing/story authority, domain activation, Phase 2 selection, Phase 3 manipulation and Crossdeck Air Handoff are outside this review.

Hosted identity was supplied, not independently queried. Direct supplied-packet schema validation remains separate from protected source qualification, merge/release authority and owner PRODUCT_ACCEPTED.
